messages.text: Where is my order? email (email hidden)
Handed to the team · order_swap.py waiver cap···· $100, gap is $101; needs a person to waive or app

Robert, I'm sorry. Nothing has moved since we spoke earlier today. Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped, and the Thor P2 swap you accepted on October 29 is still waiting on that one sign-off.

I've just checked again: a Thor P2 is still on the shelf at our US warehouse. I've put your offer to cover the $1 in front of the team along with the approval request.

Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email. You don't need to send anything else.
since the issues is 1 dollar over your allowed limit cant you give me a small credit lik e5  dollars to then allow you to finish the swap its been 40 days

I get why that looks like the obvious fix, Robert, and you're right that it's been 40 days since you ordered on October 8. But I can't add a credit just to get the swap under my limit. That would be getting around a cap ····'s there on purpose, and only the team can approve going over it.

The good news is your request is already with them, along with your offer to cover the $1. It only needs one approval. As soon as they give it, the Thor P2 goes onto Shop···· and ships from our US warehouse. Someone will get back to you by email.
its been with them for what 3 weeks

Yes, Robert, close to three weeks. You accepted the swap on October 29, and it's November 18 now. That's on us, not you. You did everything we asked, and you shouldn't have had to keep chasing it.

I can't push the approval through myself, and I'm not going to promise you a time I don't control. What I can tell you is that it's been flagged as one approval on a $1 gap, and the Thor P2 is on the shelf ready to go. The moment it's approved, you'll get the updated-order email and then tracking.
what can be done to contact a team member this is ridiculous
Handed to the team · Customer asked for a person after 3 weeks of follow-ups. Only the approval is bl

I've done what I can here, Robert. I've asked for a team member to take your case personally, not just to look at the approval. They have the full picture: you accepted the free Thor P2 swap on October 29, it's $1 over my limit, you've offered to pay that $1, and the unit is on the shelf.

You don't need to repeat anything or send anything else. Someone from the team will pick up your ticket and reply to you by email.
you keep saying that has the team interacted with you at all in the last few days

No, Robert. Not on your order, as far as I can see. Every reply on Shop···· since October 29 has come from me, and none of them has been a team member's answer. That's why you keep getting the same line from me, and I'm sorry. You deserve better than that.

I won't dress it up. Today's request is the most direct one I can make. It asks for a person to deal with you, not just for an approval, and it includes your offer to pay the $1. Their answer will come to your email.
who would i contact if i wanted to do a huge bulk order

You'd come to me, Robert. There's no separate contact for bulk orders. I take the details and pass them to the same team, so it wouldn't get to a person any faster than your swap request.

If you're serious about it, tell me which models you want, how many, and where they'd ship. I'll check live stock and pricing and send it to the team as a bulk quote. I'm not going to treat it as a way to jump the queue on Shop····, though. That request is already marked for a person.
